items.question: Which qualities pertain to human birth-classes by virtue of shared class nature?
premises: Certain qualities arise from sameness of birth-class.
These qualities are identified by that shared class basis.
Human birth-classes constitute a domain where such qualities apply.
items.inference: Therefore, the qualities grounded in sameness of birth-class are the qualities present in human birth-classes.
uncertainties: The exact scope of dharmāḥ as duties, properties, or characteristics is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Whatever qualities belong by sameness of birth-class, those same qualities are found in human birth-classes.
